content.rendered:
We’re happy to report that the coach came home from Fort’s Industrial Engine in Mansfield today where they replaced the fuel filter and the fuel pump in the Onan diesel generator and the gennie is working fine.

I spent most of the rest of the day filling the fresh water tank and then flushing out all the water lines and also fired up the water heater – both electric and propane and it works in both modes.  Also checked out the refrigerator in both LP and electric modes and also works well.

Stu and I drove the Saturn around and hooked it up to the coach with the Roadmaster tow bar just to make sure everything fits and works as it should.

Once it comes back from Craig Smith RV, we’ll then have the trailer light connection working and we will be ready to connect the coach lights to the car and we’ll be ready to hit the road!
